title: Lipoprotein Profiling and Particle Size Analysis
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrifv4e

steps.title: Separate Lipoprotein Components
steps.instruction: Load the sample into a gel permeation column designed for separating lipoprotein components to elute lipoproteins in order from larger to smaller particles.

steps.title: Analyze Cholesterol and Triglyceride Levels
steps.instruction: Feed the lipoprotein fractionated by particle size into reaction coils, react with reagents, and send the degraded products to detectors to output cholesterol and triglyceride levels as a chromatogram.

steps.title: Process Data
steps.instruction: Process the obtained data using the patented analyzing program to generate a composite chromatogram and numeric data for 4 major classes (CM, VLDL, LDL, and HDL) and 20 subclasses.
